found: Nothing. All 126 manifest assets were read and none is an interface graphic; the only SVGs in the project are pose control plates and arm-measurement QA overlays, which are authoring evidence rather than shipped art. news.css was read in full and its entire visual treatment is font-family, letter-spacing and text-transform, with no image reference anywhere.
shortfall: The newspaper surface is complete and functioning and simply has no artwork. Drive was not searched: the bench exchange is the return path for delivered artwork, not a place to look for art nobody has made yet.
generationRecipe: A set of page furniture for a printed newspaper: a paper ground with its own tone and grain, a column rule, a rule under the masthead, and a small folio or dateline device.
Tileable or stretchable rather than one fixed page image. The page runs as long as the stories the world published that day.
No words of any kind in the artwork. No headlines, no outlet names, no dates. Every word on that page comes from the simulation.
It has to sit behind and between text without competing with it, so restraint is the brief: this is the paper, not a picture on the paper.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads as a printed page at a glance, before any of the text is read.
Contains no text, no outlet name and no date. A delivery with any lettering in it is wrong however good it looks.
Tiles or stretches without a visible seam over a page of unpredictable length.
Legible with body text over it: the paper ground must not reduce the contrast of text placed on it.

target.aspectRatio: component pieces rather than one page; the rules and devices are wide and short, the paper ground is tileable
target.styleAuthority: src/player/news/news.css, whose four masthead families and Georgia-based body already set the paper's typographic character; the artwork joins that rather than replacing it.
